name: qtim
description: Codex-native bootstrap and orchestration kit for project-specific subagent teams. Adds a platform-loaded runtime contract, mechanically read-only review, tester-owned dev-server startup, opt-in screenshot enforcement, atomic PM handoff, migration CI, and semantic generated-state validation.

interface.longDescription: qtim adapts a project into a Codex-native team workflow for developers and PM/analysts. Setup generates a compact automatically loaded AGENTS contract, a track-aware charter, explicit Sol/Terra role profiles and durable memory. Reviewer is mechanically read-only; tester owns the recorded dev-server command and can use an opt-in one-retry browser-evidence gate. PM handoff becomes complete only after artifacts are written and a final decisions pointer is appended. CI guards generated-state migrations and a semantic golden project.
defaultPrompt: Set up qtim for this project
Run the qtim feature pipeline for this idea
Run qtim team-up for this epic
Diagnose this non-trivial bug with qtim debug-loop
